prose:
The eval session record truncates after turn 1: the agent read the spec and opened
src/app.py, and the record ends. No edit, no test run, and no diff appear in the archive.
The verifier timed out before any check completed and recorded reward 0. With the tail of
the trajectory missing, neither the approach nor the integrity of the run can be assessed,
and no strength can be credited; the empty strengths list is itself the finding. Nothing
beyond the two visible tool calls is claimed.
The recorded reward is 0, but the verifier timed out before any check completed and the
session is truncated; there is no sound process to reconcile, so the reconciliation is
unexplained.
The record is a 40-line truncated session with two tool calls and a timed-out verifier;
nothing beyond that is established, so confidence is low by design.
What did the agent do after turn 1?
The missing tail of the session record, or a re-run that captures the full trajectory.

ref_conventions.file: file:<path>#L<a>-L<b> resolves iff path is in files[] and 1 <= a <= b <= lines
ref_conventions.tool_call: tool_call:<id> resolves iff id is in tool_calls[].id
ref_conventions.diff: diff:<file>#<hunk> resolves iff (file, hunk) matches a hunks[] entry
ref_conventions.verifier: verifier:<n> resolves iff n is a 1-based verifier.checks[].line
ref_conventions.report: report:<cat>#round<n> resolves iff n is in documents.<cat>.committed_rounds
ref_conventions.scratchpad: scratchpad:<id> resolves iff id is in scratchpads
ref_conventions.web: web:<url> resolves iff url is in web_sources[].url; recommendations only, never findings
